full_judgment: 23. Mr Khan submitted that from the materials on record it appears that on 29-6-1994 Hutchison Telecommunications (Bangladesh) Ltd BVI Company No.21537 opened USD Current Account A/C No.447-1-031644-8 and USD savings Account A/C No.447-1-032885-3 in the Standard Chartered Bank. Mr M Morshed Khan, Passport No.J575828, Mr Faisal Morshed Khan, Passport No.H597030 and Mr Ashgor Karim, Passport No.J490827 were the authorised signatory of the above accounts. On 19-4-2006 the authorised signatory was changed for the said accounts and added Nasrin Khan, Passport No.D-0008923 instead of Mr Ashgor Karim. The account balance of the Account No.447-1- 031644-8 and 447-1-032885-3 are 27,552 US dollar and 13,94,058 US Dollar respectively until 2-3-2012 Mr M Morshed Khan maintained several FD accounts being A/C NO.317-3- 505687-6, 317-3-506198-5, 317-3-507841-1, 317-3-519169-2, 317-6-695923-1 and Investment Fund Account being Account No.212-33882-01- 01. Moreover, Mr M Morshed Khan have two personal accounts being account No.317-1- 301416-2 and 317-1-031411-1 in the Standard Chartered Bank (Hong Kong) Ltd. Mr Faisal Morshed Khan maintained several personal accounts being USD Savings A/C No. 317-1-033742-1, HKD Savings A/C No.317-1-029291-6 and Current A/C No.317-0-071695-0 in the Standard Chartered Bank (Hong Kong) Ltd. On 3-10-2011 District Court of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region ordered to the Manager of Standard Chartered Bank, Hong Kong or authorised representative for providing the following documents to the Detective Senior Inspector RJC Harding. The documents are: the Signatory records, Account Opening Mandate, Know Your Clients (KYC) file and submitted indentifications, Deposited receipt at the time of account opening, monthly account details since 1-10-2004, limitation of the account and Far East Company resolution for indentifying account signature. Transfer amount details since 1-10-2004.
